# truenas_dataset_lock (Action)

Locks a passphrase-encrypted dataset (pool.dataset.lock), making its data inaccessible until unlocked.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Lock an encrypted dataset (unmounts it and unloads its key).
action "truenas_dataset_lock" "secret" {
  config {
    dataset      = truenas_dataset.secret.name
    force_umount = true
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dataset` (String) Full path of the encrypted dataset to lock, e.g. "tank/secret".

### Optional

- `force_umount` (Boolean) Force-unmount the dataset if it is busy.
